result.title: TPPO: Tracking-Value PPO For Language Model Reasoning
result.summary: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for language-model reasoning. While \emph{value evolution along trajectory} characterizes relative token-level credit, yet standard critics often fail to track it under sparse terminal rewards. To model this evolution, we analyze the relation between successive prefix values and show that they admit a Bayesian decomposition with additive updates in log-odds space. We use this additive structure to construct Tracking-Value PPO (\method), a cumulative value parameterization that sums position-wise scalar outputs into value logits. These outputs are learned through terminal-outcome supervision on the reconstructed values. \method improves aggregate mathematical reasoning scores over PPO by 7.0 and 8.4 points on Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base, respectively, while improving out-of-distribution generalization. Gains extend to Qwen3-4B, Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Qwen3.5-9B and to countdown, and scientific coding tasks. Further analysis shows more accurate tracking of value evolution and more reliable advantage estimates. Our code is publicly available in https://github.com/LINs-lab/TPPO.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 TPPO：利用相邻前缀价值在 log-odds 空间满足贝叶斯加性分解，把 critic 改为按位置标量输出累加的值 logits，并仅用终端结果监督学习重构价值，在多个 Qwen 模型与数学、倒计时、科学编程任务上提升推理分数与分布外泛化。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本 RL 工作，不涉及视觉状态或 latent 生成，但其「沿轨迹追踪值演化」与按位置加性参数化、终端监督可能为 LVR 的贡献分配、latent 状态逐步更新与信用监督提供可核查线索。
